page.overview:
Who is Snub-nosed Monkey Spirit King?

The is one of the six demon kings allied with Sun Wukong.

The Snub-nosed Monkey Spirit King met Sun Wukong during his travels around the world after becoming immortal and became sworn brothers with him and five other demon kings. Sun Wukong frequently hosted extravagant banquets for them. After Sun Wukong took the title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, the Snub-nosed Monkey Spirit King began calling itself the Great Sage Who Moves Mountains.

Category:Males Category:Spirits Category:Monkeys
